title: Feature
description: A perk. In this classless ruleset, perks are the single character-defining progression table, gated by skill thresholds, prerequisite perks, and attributes. The `type` distinguishes how a perk is acquired: normal perks are chosen on level-up, `creation` perks (the former 'traits') are chosen at character creation and usually carry a tradeoff, and `racial_trait` perks are granted automatically by ancestry.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

type.description: How the perk is acquired. perk = chosen from the perk table on level-up; creation = chosen at character creation (the former 'traits', usually with a tradeoff); racial_trait = granted automatically by ancestry (pinned to a race); universal = always available

abilities.description: Minimum attribute values, keyed by attribute id (e.g. { "agi": 6 })

skills.description:
Minimum skill values. Each item references a skill by its numeric id (from skills/core.json). The label is duplicated for readability. The 'min' field is the required value.

To support general 'range' perks (e.g. any of the split ranged skills), 'id' and 'label' may be arrays. When 'id' is an array, the prerequisite is satisfied by meeting the 'min' value in *any one* of the listed skills (with matching names in the 'label' array). This reuses the original single-id structure while allowing multiple acceptable skills. Specific perks should continue using a single scalar id.

oneOf.description: Array of acceptable skill refs. The prerequisite is met if the character has the required min in any one of them.

label.description: Human-readable label of the skill (duplicated from the skills registry for convenience). When 'id' is an array, this should be a parallel array of the corresponding skill names, or a single descriptive string.

perks.description: Prerequisite perk refs (namespaced core:feature/<key>) that must already be owned

ranks.description: Maximum number of times this perk can be taken (1 = single-rank)

target.description: Reference to the target of this effect. Use namespaced ref (core:effect/<key>) or ad-hoc string key (hp_max, melee_damage, etc.).

parameter.description: For generic parameterized effects (e.g. 'resist', 'restore_resource', 'fortify_attribute', 'phobia', 'allergy', 'cure'), specifies the subject. Use string key (bare or namespaced) when referencing another collection's key (skill, material, etc.); vocabulary for built-in values.

durationType.description: For fortify effects on skills/attributes/resources: 'unlimited' are stackable (additive magnitudes for permanent traits). 'temporal' override with the highest magnitude.
